commands.command: that's game over. your health has reached zero. you have died.
lately you have: examine shelves; examine gourd; inventory; go east; take gourd; go south; go west; go west.
lately you have: examine tallow; go south; go east; go north; examine stone slabs; examine floor; drop blue gourd.

as you examine the shelves in the dim light, your health finally gives out. the lack of food and warmth becomes too much to bear. the blue gourd drops from your lifeless hand as you collapse onto the cold stone floor. the last thing you see is the flickering shadows on the shelves above, and the untouched gourd rolling away into the darkness.
there are no more items here. your health is getting critically low. i need to find food soon or i won't survive.
you open the blue gourd. all is dark.
